title: WP-EVT-002 event envelope metadata v1
description: Shared metadata only; no production payload, publisher, subject, authorization or runtime readiness is defined.

event_id.description: Immutable fact identity, retained across retries and replay; UUID4 generation does not constrain supplied opaque IDs.

schema_version.description: Positive event schema version; not an entity revision.

world_id.description: Explicit operational world; never inferred or authenticated by this schema.

correlation_id.description: Business-chain identity, distinct from software trace identity.

causation_id.description: Direct causal predecessor; explicit null for a root event. Omission is invalid.

trace_id.description: Software execution identity; may change on replay without changing EventID.

observed_at.description: UTC platform observation time; never a substitute for simulation occurrence.

entity_refs.description: Explicit typed opaque references; empty only when no entity context applies. Event-specific cardinality remains the payload owner responsibility.

Identity.description: Opaque nonblank string, preserved unchanged; not coerced or interpreted as a counter.

UtcInstant.description: Gregorian UTC instant, year 0001-9999, seconds 00-59, optional 1-6 fractional digits; Z or +00:00. Matches canonical Python datetime output without optional format-checker dependencies.

seconds.description: Finite seconds on the named simulation clock, with no implicit UTC epoch. Supplied by the domain/simulator authority, never derived from observation time.
